financial_package.pay_source_label: Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2019, Government Resolution No. RPS-2019/CR-1/Services-9
financial_package.estimate_note: Basic pay ₹38,600 in Level S-14. As ASO postings are exclusively at Mantralaya (State Secretariat in Mumbai, an X-category metropolis), officers draw 27% HRA (₹10,422) + 58% DA (₹22,388) + Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + DA), yielding an in-hand estimate of approximately ₹64,000 to ₹72,000 after standard deductions (NPS 10%, Professional Tax, GIS).
official_perks: Government staff quarters eligibility in Mumbai or maximum metro HRA (27%)
Fixed 5-day working week at Mantralaya Secretariat
Comprehensive medical treatment reimbursement under Maharashtra Government Health Scheme
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and gazetted holiday entitlements
Secretariat allowance / special duty allowances where authorized
Contributory pension scheme benefits under NPS
